---
title: "simstim policy log"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read one session's network decisions.

```text
simstim policy log --in <host>/<session> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
simstim policy log --in my-vps/auth-fix --since 1h
simstim policy log --in my-vps/auth-fix --follow --json
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--by <string>` | read classifier decisions only |
| `--door <string>` | the door to read (net) (default: `net`) |
| `--follow` | poll the host's audit log for new decisions |
| `--in <string>` | the session whose decisions to read |
| `--json` | print JSON for scripts, and ask nothing (see docs/how-to/scripting.md) |
| `--since <string>` | read from a timestamp or a duration such as 1h |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`policy`](policy.md): read and change sandbox policy at any layer.
